name: White Dragon Slayer
description: (Tag:holy)(Tag:light)(Tag:transformation)Allows you to transform into and wield the powers of a white dragon. You generate and control Holy Light from your body, alter its properties such as blunt or sharp, and are immune to all Light and Holy attributes below your level. Eating light energy and holy objects recovers vitality and energy, and consuming other magic lets you temporarily incorporate it into your light.
